name: sdrift-isort-isort-002-shared
instr:
# Correct behaviour that contradicts isort's documentation

QA on `isort` (a Python library and formatter for sorting and organizing imports) surfaced outputs that don't line up with the documentation (the prose documentation under /app/docs/configuration and public API docstrings under /app/isort).
The functions run without error but produce values the docs say are wrong. Locate the mismatches and
fix the implementation so its behaviour follows the documentation.

Work only in `/app/isort/`; do not change the API, signatures, or layout, and do not add files. No
internet. Hidden inputs grade the documented behaviour (configuration defaults, import formatting, comment handling, placement, and sorting helpers).

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/NOTES.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
